question: Where was the Katakkar Trophy's All India Inter-Club Winter Water Polo League (2024-25) held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tilak Tank, Deccan Gymkhana, Pune**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The **Katakkar Trophy's All India Inter-Club Winter Water Polo League** for the year **2024-25** was held at the **Tilak Tank, Deccan Gymkhana, Pune**, a venue known for hosting various water sports events. 
• **Tilak Tank** is located at the **Deccan Gymkhana Club** in Pune, Maharashtra, which is a renowned center for sports and recreational activities. 
• The event witnessed participation from numerous water polo clubs across India, showcasing talent and competitive spirit in the field of **water polo**. 
• The **Deccan Gymkhana Club** is historically significant and has hosted several state and national-level sports events, making it a perfect venue for such a prestigious tournament. 
• Water polo leagues like the Katakkar Trophy play a crucial role in promoting the sport and encouraging young athletes to participate in aquatic sports. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
• **Tilak Tank, Pune:** 
• Located within the premises of the **Deccan Gymkhana Club**, Tilak Tank is a well-maintained swimming and water sports facility. 
• It is named after **Bal Gangadhar Tilak**, a prominent freedom fighter and social reformer from Maharashtra. 
• The facility is equipped with a standard-sized pool suitable for hosting professional water polo tournaments. 
• Over the years, it has become a hub for swimming, water polo, and other aquatic sports in the region. 
• **Importance of Water Polo in India:** 
• Water polo is a growing sport in India, with a rich history and a dedicated following. 
• Events like the **Katakkar Trophy** encourage participation at the grassroots level, helping to nurture talent. 
• It is governed by the **Swimming Federation of India (SFI)**, which oversees water polo events and promotes the sport nationwide. 
• India has had notable performances in water polo at the **Asian Games** and other international competitions in the past. 
• **Deccan Gymkhana Club:** 
• Established in **1906**, the Deccan Gymkhana Club is one of the oldest sports clubs in Pune. 
• It offers facilities for a range of sports, including swimming, cricket, tennis, badminton, and athletics. 
• It has been a breeding ground for numerous national and international athletes over the years. 
• **Other Venues Considered:** 
• **Shivaji Park Swimming Complex, Mumbai:** A popular venue for swimming and water polo events in Mumbai, but not the host for the 2024-25 Katakkar Trophy. 
• **Balewadi Sports Complex, Pune:** Known for hosting large-scale sports events, but this specific league was held at Tilak Tank. 
• **Shiv Nadar Aquatics Centre, Hyderabad:** A premier aquatic facility in Hyderabad, but it was not selected as the venue for this tournament. 
• **Significance of Katakkar Trophy:** 
• The Katakkar Trophy is a highly regarded water polo league in India, aimed at promoting inter-club competition and enhancing the sport's visibility. 
• It helps in identifying emerging talent and providing players with a platform to showcase their skills. </ul
